messages:
alex: starting rollout of taproot v2 -> rolling 10% traffic now. deploy job 3578 started. watch SLOs (p99/p95/error rate). dashboard: https://dash.redwood/slo/taproot

deploy-bot: rollout initiated by alex — canary=10% (3 pods) — job=3578 — status: in_progress :rocket:

maria: quick check: p95 on inference-route +40ms vs baseline but still < SLO. p50 unchanged. errors 0.1% (baseline ~0.06%)

jamie: seeing a small 429 spike from eu-west-2 on shard-7, forwarding logs now

sre-jen: pulling traces, looks like retries from clients. any rate-limit changes in this deploy?

alex: no rate-limit changes. this patch is kv-cache memory tweak + kernel bump. could be transient. recommend hold at 10% for 15m and reevaluate. @oncall-bot set timer 15m

oncall-bot: timer set for 15 minutes. will ping thread at end of timer.

maria: agree with hold. enabling prefetched cache for canary traffic to isolate effect

jamie: logs snippet: ```503 gateway shard-7 | connection reset by peer | pod taproot-7-2 restart```

sre-jen: infra alerts show one pod OOMKilled in eu-west-2 and restarted ~2m ago. eviction due to memory pressure noted

alex: ok — to avoid user impact, pin eu-west-2 traffic back to v1 for now. command I ran: `redwood route pin --model taproot@v1 --region eu-west-2`

deploy-bot: route pin accepted (eu-west-2 -> taproot@v1). canary remains 10% in other regions. job=3578 status=partial_hold

maria: SLOs normalizing in eu-west-2 after pin. p95 back to baseline within 2m. no user-facing error reports so far

alex: good. filing an infra follow-up and will update release notes. Jamie, please add OOM logs + pod memory footprint to ticket. I'll mark this for postmortem if recurring :white_check_mark:

jamie: added notes and logs to RED-1234 (infra). will keep monitoring for another 30m and report

sre-jen: leaving monitoring hooks on. if p95 drifts >20% or error rate >0.5% we escalate and rollback fully

alex: thanks everyone. holding rollout until infra confirms fix, will update here when we resume ramp.
